summary: The fix for the orphaned-commit finding was the same defect with a delay. be74e52 is reachable from this branch ONLY, and main here is strictly linear -- squash or rebase, no merge commits -- so citing it would have broken 4.7 by the act of merging. In a squash-merge repository no feature-branch commit is a citable revision; a citation to your own branch is a certainty with a delay, and it is worse than a bare number because it LOOKS like provenance. Fixed by citing content plus a procedure: delete the two containment cases, set expectedCases to 86, and both mutants pass 86/86 -- runnable against the merged tree forever.
evidence: command:git ls-remote origin matches neither b689137 nor be74e52, and git log --format=%p over origin/main shows every recent commit with exactly one parent; command:removing the two containment cases and setting expectedCases to 86 lets both containment mutants pass 86/86 at exit 0; file:feedback/2026-08-02-Rogue3-23.md
cost: one review round, and a remedy that had to be discarded because it was an instance of the defect it fixed
